text:
```yaml
name: pre-commit autofix trigger

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  trigger:
    if: github.event.pull_request.user.type == 'Bot' || endsWith(github.actor, '[bot]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      checks: read
      statuses: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Trigger pre-commit autofix
        uses: shaypal5/pre-commit-ci-autofix-trigger@v1
```
